_note: The company the demo is about, shown in the sidebar as the case study. Facts come from its collective labour agreement (PKB, published on wageindicator.org) and from the regulations listed; the employees and wages in the calculator scenarios are illustrative, not company data. The status of each regulation is not stored here: the app reads it from the knowledge base (locked in the starting knowledge base, added in the app, or not added yet). Regulations are listed by issue date.
label: Case study
name: PT TKG Taekwang Indonesia
summary: A footwear factory in Subang, West Java. Its pay and benefits follow a collective labour agreement with the unions, and as a labour-intensive industry it receives the government's PPh 21 and JKK incentives. The demo starts from the knowledge known on 29 Feb 2024; the labour agreement and the 2025-2026 regulations are added in the app.
facts: Collective labour agreement (PKB) 2024-2026, signed 15 Mar 2024, in force from its registration (about 28 Mar 2024, estimated: the day is not legible) to 28 Mar 2026
Labour-intensive industry: PPh 21 borne by the government (DTP) for employees with fixed regular income up to Rp10,000,000 a month
Medium, 0.89% (assumed; BPJS sets it per company)
Five illustrative employees A-E in the calculator; wages are illustrative
earlier_rules: Also in the starting knowledge base: the rules recorded since 2009 (PTKP, Article 17 rates, position cost, social security contributions).
